sprint_goal: Ship a secured, observable alert system: authenticate the Render API against public access, complete the alert engine with configurable thresholds and evaluation history, close QA scenario gaps from v2.1, and deliver three governance process improvements that streamline all future cycles.

findings_applied: §1 rewritten from 'out of scope' to canonical X-API-Key scheme (header, server env var API_KEY, client env var REACT_APP_API_KEY, 401 envelope, exempt endpoint table, OpenAPI reference)
Informational: openapi.yaml 'future use' description cleaned up in ST-01 implementation commit — done
Informational: /health path-level security: [] override added in ST-01 implementation commit — done

ST-01.notes: Implementation complete (commit 43be2ef). FastAPI middleware added to main.py (X-API-Key vs API_KEY env var; 401 on missing/invalid; GET /health exempt). doFetch in base44Client.js updated to send X-API-Key. apiFetch() helper exported for pages with raw fetch() calls. All 9 affected frontend files migrated. openapi.yaml ApiKey description cleaned; GET /health security: [] added. All existing tests pass (19 passed, 13 pre-existing skips). DoQ sign-off pending: (a) 401 path tested; (b) REACT_APP_API_KEY env var wiring confirmed on Render; (c) no endpoint left unprotected.
